'''Sirrakuk''' was the younger sister of [[Lowbacca]] and niece of the famous [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] hero [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. She shaved distinctive patches into her fur and loved to fly [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

Sirra completed her rite of passage (which she was hesitant to do because of the supposed [[Death/Legends|death]] of her friend [[Raabakyysh|Raaba]] while doing hers) during a fight with the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Vonnda Ra]] in the lower levels of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Both Sirra and Ra were swallowed by a [[Syren plant/Legends|syren plant]], but Sirra escaped and grabbed a handful of fibers on her way out.

Later, after Raaba turned up alive, well, and promoting the [[Diversity Alliance]] on Kashyyyk, Sirra and Lowbacca accompanied her to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], where the pair were held against their will until they escaped. Sirra later accompanied a [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] team sent to investigate claims about the Diversity Alliance, and in frustration, smashed open a crate marked "medical supplies", exposing the weapons inside. She was employed as an emergency pilot for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sirrakuk was first mentioned in the [[1995]] novel ''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones]]'' by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]] as the unidentified sister of Lowbacca.<ref name="The Lost Ones" /> She first appeared in the [[1996]] [[Star Wars: Young Jedi Knights|''Young Jedi Knights'']] novel ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Darkest Knight]]'' by Anderson and Moesta, where her name was revealed as Sirrakuk.<ref name="Darkest Knight" />
